title: Systematic elimination of local gravitational models on the SPARC 175 sample: Evidence for an irreducible galaxy-specific degree of freedom
abstract: This paper performs a systematic elimination study of baryon-based rotation-curve models on the SPARC 175 sample. It shows that all purely local multiplicative models with only global parameters fail in low-acceleration (FLOW) galaxies, while a minimal hybrid model with a single galaxy-specific amplitude matches NFW halo fit performance with half the per-galaxy parameters. The study finds the added amplitude is a stable, intrinsic galaxy property that cannot be predicted from standard baryonic observables.
